PyMAF-X.comparison: The author-hosted TPAMI manuscript and latest arXiv v4 both retain the Table1 PyMAF(HR48) values 78.0/47.1/91.3 and its with-3DPW variant 74.2/45.3/87.0. Latest v4 is the primary inspected screenshot; no publisher-PDF byte-identity claim is made.

reporting_decisions: All four supplied numeric pairs match original-author self-method rows; none needs correction merely because it also appears in later literature.
Use explicit backbone/training labels. The screenshot mixes no-3DPW-training PyMAF, PARE, and PyMAF-X-body results with CLIFF trained on 3DPW.
Name the 78.0/47.1 row PyMAF-X (body expert, HR48) or PyMAF-HR48 (TPAMI2023). Its literal original row is PyMAF(HR48); this is not a full SMPL-X whole-body result.
Do not silently present PARE 82.0/50.9 as its strongest official variant: PARE w.3DPW reports 74.5/46.5. Likewise retain knowledge of PyMAF-X-body w.3DPW 74.2/45.3.
Literature rows are author-reported 3DPW test results. They do not establish equal crops/training or convert C10 validation results into test results.
PyMAF ICCV2021 and its TPAMI2023 extension are related method versions; retaining both screenshot rows does not make them independent framework families.
remaining_unknowns: No explicit test-time flip setting was established for these four original rows in this narrow audit.
The exact screenshot provenance cannot be uniquely inferred from its numeric pairs.
